description: Claiming protection from a state is incompatible with returning to it. Re-availment can void the status granted.

aspect: Conscription liability does the same without a claim
description: A man who never served faces detention or forced service on return, so the door closes even for someone with no political profile.
Most migrants can go home if it does not work. Removing that option changes every calculation: a bad job, a bad marriage, a bad city must be endured.
The concrete form this takes is a parent dying while the son cannot attend. It recurs in Iranian diaspora accounts more than any other single loss.
notes: For narrative use: this is the emotional centre of the whole dataset.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the estate you cannot settle
description: A DOHA applicant refused to surrender his Iranian passport because he needed it to settle his father's estate in Iran, and lost his clearance for it. Returning for a death in the family and keeping a career were incompatible.

Nasrin calls at four in the morning. Their father has had a stroke and is in Sina Hospital. Omid has not served. If he goes he may not come back; if he does not go he may not see his father again. He is on the phone to an immigration lawyer by six and at his desk by nine, because there is nothing to decide.
energy_note: The decision that is not a decision, because one option does not exist.
